mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate above 4.5% over the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5% in a month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate contracting consumer demand and business investment, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction signal Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing supply shock regime (INDPRO below 100 for two consecutive months), production bottlenecks reduce corporate output and margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with INDPRO < 100 for two months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1450 thousand units in the prior month signals reduced residential investment and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1450, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls over the prior month indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL above 330 for two consecutive months), restrictive monetary policy reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 330 for two months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly growth in real GDP above 2.0% signals robust economic expansion that boosts corporate profits and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
